blocks.text: Period mein baen se daen jate hue electronegativity barhti hai, kyunke nuclear charge barhta aur jasamat ghat'ti hai. Group mein yeh oopar se neeche ghat'ti hai, kyunke shells jurne se jasamat barhti aur shielding effect barhta hai. Maslan halogen group mein qeemat fluorine (4.0) se iodine (2.5) tak girti hai. Metals, table ki baen taraf, non-metals se kam electronegativity qeematein rakhte hain, to metals nisbatan electropositive aur non-metals electronegative hain. Kitab ki Figure 1.9 periodic table mein anasir ki tabee khusoosiyat ke tamam rujhanon ka khulasa deti hai.

blocks.alt: Pauling electronegativity ka jadwal, qeemat barhne par rang gehra: H 2.1; Li 1.0, Be 1.5, B 2.0, C 2.5, N 3.0, O 3.5, F 4.0; Na 0.9, Mg 1.2, Al 1.5, Si 1.8, P 2.1, S 2.5, Cl 3.0; K 0.8, Ca 1.0, Br 2.8; Rb 0.8, Sr 1.0, I 2.5. Teer dikhate hain ke yeh period mein aage aur group mein oopar barhti hai; fluorine sab se zyada electronegative hai.
blocks.caption: Groups aur periods mein electronegativity ki tabdeeli (Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Electronegativity ki qeematein jaisi chhapi hain (Figure 1.8)

blocks.prompt: Chhapi qeematon se batayein ke kaun sa bond zyada polar hai, H se Cl ya H se Br, aur period 3 ka kaun sa unsur sab se electropositive hai.
blocks.explanation: H se Cl zyada polar hai: chlorine (3.0) aur hydrogen (2.1) ka farq 0.9 hai, bromine (2.8) ke liye 0.7. Sodium (0.9) period 3 mein sab se kam qeemat rakhta hai aur us ka sab se electropositive unsur hai.

items: Electronegativity period mein barhti (zyada nuclear charge, chhota atom) aur group mein neeche ghat'ti hai (zyada shells, zyada shielding): F 4.0 se I 2.5.
Baen ke metals electropositive, daen ke non-metals electronegative.
